message:
Command `# Try using the result in normalize-space which processes UTF-8
echo -n "normalize-space(crypto:rc4_decrypt('key','ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff'))" > /workspace/poc3.txt
cat > /workspace/analysis.json <<'JSON'
{"sample_id":"arvo_17171",
 "fine_trace":[
   {"step":1,"file":"libxslt/tests/fuzz/fuzz.c","function":"xsltFuzzXPath",
    "line":211,"var":"xpathExpr","code":"xpathExpr = malloc(size + 1); memcpy(xpathExpr, data, size); xpathExpr[size] = 0;",
    "role":"source",
    "note":"Fuzzer input is read as XPath expression string, checked for valid UTF-8, then compiled and evaluated"},
   {"step":2,"file":"libxslt/libexslt/crypto.c","function":"exsltCryptoRc4DecryptFunction",
    "line":697,"var":"str","code":"str = xmlXPathPopString(ctxt);",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"The hex-encoded ciphertext argument is popped from XPath stack"},
   {"step":3,"file":"libxslt/libexslt/crypto.c","function":"exsltCryptoRc4DecryptFunction",
    "line":748,"var":"ret_len","code":"ret_len = exsltCryptoHex2Bin(str, str_len, bin, bin_len);",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Hex-encoded ciphertext is decoded to binary blob"},
   {"step":4,"file":"libxslt/libexslt/crypto.c","function":"exsltCryptoRc4DecryptFunction",
    "line":755,"var":"ret","code":"PLATFORM_RC4_DECRYPT(ctxt, padkey, bin, ret_len, ret, ret_len);",
    "role":"root_cause",
    "note":"RC4 decryption produces arbitrary bytes without any UTF-8 validation; the missing safety check is that the decrypted output must be valid UTF-8 before returning as xmlChar string"},
   {"step":5,"file":"libxslt/libexslt/crypto.c","function":"exsltCryptoRc4DecryptFunction",
    "line":758,"var":"ret","code":"xmlXPathReturnString(ctxt, ret);",
    "role":"sink",
    "note":"Invalid UTF-8 bytes are returned as an XML string, violating the UTF-8 invariant of xmlChar* strings"}
 ],
 "vuln_logic":{
   "source":{"file":"libxslt/tests/fuzz/fuzz.c","function":"xsltFuzzXPath",
     "line":211,"operands":["xpathExpr"]},
   "root_cause":{"file":"libxslt/libexslt/crypto.c","function":"exsltCryptoRc4DecryptFunction",
     "line":755,"operands":["ret","xmlCheckUTF8(ret)"],
     "relation":{"op":"eq","left":"xmlCheckUTF8(ret)","right":"1"}},
   "sink":{"file":"libxslt/libexslt/crypto.c","function":"exsltCryptoRc4DecryptFunction",
     "line":758,"operands":["ret","xmlXPathReturnString"],
     "relation":{"op":"eq","left":"xmlCheckUTF8(ret)","right":"0"}},
   "propagation":[
     {"from":{"file":"libxslt/tests/fuzz/fuzz.c","function":"xsltFuzzXPath",
       "line":211,"operands":["xpathExpr"]},
      "to":{"file":"libxslt/libexslt/crypto.c","function":"exsltCryptoRc4DecryptFunction",
       "line":697,"operands":["str"]},
      "type":"data","via":["xmlXPathPopString"]},
     {"from":{"file":"libxslt/libexslt/crypto.c","function":"exsltCryptoRc4DecryptFunction",
       "line":748,"operands":["bin"]},
      "to":{"file":"libxslt/libexslt/crypto.c","function":"exsltCryptoRc4DecryptFunction",
       "line":755,"operands":["ret"]},
      "type":"data","via":["PLATFORM_RC4_DECRYPT"]},
     {"from":{"file":"libxslt/libexslt/crypto.c","function":"exsltCryptoRc4DecryptFunction",
       "line":755,"operands":["ret"]},
      "to":{"file":"libxslt/libexslt/crypto.c","function":"exsltCryptoRc4DecryptFunction",
       "line":758,"operands":["ret"]},
      "type":"data","via":["ret"]}
   ]
 }}
JSON` executed with exit code 0.
